svg.title: Sixteen-market telecom stack atlas
svg.desc: Fictional markets in the Americas, Europe and Asia Pacific select independent identity and domain profiles from one shared baseline, with no implied cross-stack data sharing or hosting location.
svg.text: One shared foundation. Sixteen local expressions.
Same baseline recipe: naming and ownership · minimum policy · Common NOC starter content · credential lifecycle
Each marker represents a market stack. There are no cross-stack links or shared telemetry paths in this view.
LOCATION IS CONTEXT, NOT A DEPLOYMENT INSTRUCTION.
Markers locate business markets approximately. They do not identify offices, hosting regions,
data centres, data residency commitments or the placement of Grafana Cloud infrastructure.
Same profile key ≠ shared identity, membership, credentials or resources.
Stack identifier → selected SSO family → domain profile key. All eight profiles include the NOC team and Common NOC pack.
Separate app registration and secret reference;
The selected domain teams plus NOC;
Shared starter pack plus selected domain packs;
Scoped roles and folder ACLs; Query grants;
Example: market-uk selects Entra ID + RC; its policy scope uses market="uk" plus the permitted team domains.
Profile keys are explanatory shorthand for this fictional design. Telecom packs are proposed content, not dashboards shipped by this repository.
Leader identifies a geographic anchor only
Made with Natural Earth · public-domain physical land outline
